digest.component_or_area: rebar lifecycle policy enforcement and dogfood
propositions: Material-pin and close-review enforcement policies must be enabled in rebar.toml while library defaults remain false, and legacy unpinned attestations must continue to pass both gates.

End-to-end lifecycle tests must prove that direct and transitive invalidation propagate only after actual material changes, and that unchanged successful re-review produces no further downstream propagation.
Outgoing depends_on and inbound blocks references to the same prerequisite must normalize to one canonical pin and one evaluation without redundant propagation.
Stale material-pin drift must reject claim or close with exit 1, leave status unchanged, and report the canonical stale target and stale-pin-drift reason token.
Missing or phase-incompatible close-plan review must reject close with exit 1, leave status in_progress, and instruct operator to run review-plan.
No eager backfill, graph-wide invalidation event, new pin command, ordinary-list output change, or stored relation migration must be introduced.
